description: This Java source file defines the ProductStoreEvents class, which contains a static method for retrieving and constructing a hierarchical tree of product store groups in a JSON-compatible format. It interacts with the OFBiz framework's entity engine to query product store group data and prepares a structure for use in a frontend component, such as a tree view.

classes.name: ProductStoreEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to fetch and build hierarchical data structures related to product store groups for frontend use.

methods.name: getChildProductStoreGroupTree
methods.description: Retrieves child product store groups for a given parent group ID, constructs a JSON-like data structure for rendering in a tree view, and sorts the result by sequence number.
